text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick thread — trying to distill the benchmark narrative so it actually helps sales and isn't just 'fast vs cheap'. two things we need: 1) one shareable chart that slices latency vs $/k tokens by common workloads (chat 2k, generation 500, embedding 256). 2) a short social post + webinar hook that highlights actionable tradeoffs.

Jon (Growth): +1 on actionable. Can we have a tiny 'if you care about X, choose Y' box on the chart? That made our last campaign convert better.

Lina (Product): Recommend we show 3 concrete workload personas: Search, Assist, Bulk-embed. Each gets a callout with latency target and cost goal.

Chris (Data Viz): I'll sketch two visuals:
- heatmap: x=latency (p50,p95), y=cost per 1k tokens; dots sized by throughput.
- stacked area: tail-latency vs cost across batching configs.
Draft labels:
```
Heatmap axes: Latency (ms) →, Cost ($/1k tokens) ↑
Colors: green=preferred zone, amber=tradeoff, red=expensive-slow
Persona callouts: Search (p95<200ms), Assist (p50<50ms), Bulk (cost-first)
```
I'll post a figma link when ready.

Sam (Content): For social/webinar copy: short hook + outcome. Example: "Benchmarking inference: how we cut 3x token-cost without blowing up tail latency — and when to tradeoff." CTA -> 'See the chart + RSVP'.

Maya (Marketing): Love it. Also need inbound routing: if someone clicks the chart CTA, we want to send them to a 1-pager then route to SDR if they view pricing table. Simple flow: chart -> 1-pager (email gated) -> if company size >50 or >500k tokens/mo tagged for SDR.

Jon (Growth): Can we capture 'what workload' in the gating form? checkbox: Search/Assist/Bulk. Use that to personalize webinar invite.

Lina (Product): Also add a small note on fallbacks: show how we automatically route to cheaper quantized model with small quality diff when throughput spikes.

Chris (Data Viz): Action: I'll drop Figma mocks by Thu EOD. Sam can draft 2 social captions and 1 webinar blurb by Fri.

Sam (Content): On it. Will post options and we can A/B test tone.

Maya (Marketing): Awesome — owners: Chris (charts), Sam (copy), Jon (routing logic + funnel), Lina (persona defs). Next sync: Tue 10am. :calendar:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — 'Bench narrative kickoff' Tue 10:00

Maya (Marketing): If anyone has numbers we should highlight (quantization savings, avg p95, tokens/sec), drop them here.

Lina (Product): I'll add a short table with p50/p95 and $/1k for the models we benchmarked — expect in a PR by tomorrow.

Jon (Growth): I'll wire the form and tagging in HubSpot after we finalize personas.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Thanks team :sparkles:
